definitions.full: H729. araz ארז (compare Arabic be firm , also withdraw, retreat ). [ אָרוּז ] adjective firm, strong (compare Arabic above) אֲרֻזִים Ezek 27:24 .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to be firm; used only in the passive participle as a denominative from 730 ;
